reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Swampland agent duties, federal claims, and assistants
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/prior-revisions notes (RSMo 1939 § 12775; 1929 § 11151; 1919 § 7015; 1909 § 8018). Covers the secretary of state acting as swampland agent to locate lands under the September 28, 1850 and subsequent federal acts, settle state claims against the United States, obtain county commission proof for indemnity under the March 2, 1855 act, and employ assistants for sections 241.010 to 241.280 subject to gubernatorial approval.

headings.title: Handling indemnity moneys, scrip, locations, and county notice
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history notes. Distinguished from subsection 1 by detailing receipt and state-treasury deposit of federal swampland indemnity moneys or scrip to county credit, record cancellation, sight/personal-knowledge location of indemnity certificates in county names, deposit of location certificates subject to county commission orders, and immediate notice to county commissions.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both subsections and all history/prior-revisions notes (RSMo 1939 § 12775; 1929 § 11151; 1919 § 7015; 1909 § 8018) and verified all source and subsection fingerprints. Checked secretary of state swampland agent duties under the September 28, 1850 and March 2, 1855 federal acts, governor-approved assistants under sections 241.010 to 241.280, treasury deposits of indemnity moneys/scrip, office record cancellation, sight/personal-knowledge locations, and immediate county commission notice. Retained both drafted titles as accurate.

headings.title: Landowner objection and jury assessment of damages
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/prior-revisions notes (RSMo 1939 § 12759, A.L. 1945 p. 1110, A.L. 1986 H.B. 1554 Revision). Covers landowner objection to a proposed ditch or levee under sections 241.010 to 241.280, application by drainage and reclamation commissioners to an associate circuit judge for a sheriff summons of eighteen persons to meet on the land, selection of a twelve-person jury, oath, and written damages verdict.

headings.title: Associate circuit court trial procedure and docket entry
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history notes. Specifies that jury selection and trial follow civil procedure in associate divisions of circuit courts and directs the associate circuit judge to enter the verdict and proceedings on the docket.

headings.title: Damages payment or tender, suit bar, costs, and appeal
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history notes. Covers filing the transcript with the county commission clerk, discretionary county commission warrants for damages and officer fees from unappropriated section 241.010 to 241.280 land-sale proceeds, treasurer receipts, authority to proceed and bar against owner suit after payment or refused tender, treasury custody of refused tender, complainant liability for costs if no damages are found, and right of appeal.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all three subsections and all history/prior-revisions notes (RSMo 1939 § 12759, A.L. 1945 p. 1110, A.L. 1986 H.B. 1554 Revision) and verified all source and subsection fingerprints. Checked landowner protest under sections 241.010 to 241.280, 18-person sheriff summons and 12-person jury damages verdict, associate circuit court civil procedure and docket entry, discretionary county commission payment warrant from unappropriated land-sale proceeds, suit bar on payment or refused tender, complainant cost liability on zero damages, and appeal right. Retained all three drafted titles as accurate.

headings.title: River islands already formed and transfer sequence
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1971 H.B. 140 §§ 1, 2). Applies notwithstanding sections 241.290 to 241.340 to unappropriated state-owned islands already formed in the Missouri and Mississippi rivers, establishing conditional sequential transfer from the Missouri conservation commission (wildlife) to the state park board (recreation) to respective counties upon certifications of no present or potential value.

headings.title: River islands formed after September 28, 1971
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Distinguished from subsection 1 by addressing islands formed in the Missouri and Mississippi rivers after September 28, 1971, affirming state ownership, applying subsection 1 transfer sequence, and specifying county survey and sale powers under sections 241.291, 241.309, and 241.311 if both state agencies certify no value.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both subsections and history note (L. 1971 H.B. 140 §§ 1, 2) and verified all source and subsection fingerprints. Verified the critical statutory distinction between subsection 1 (unappropriated state-owned Missouri/Mississippi River islands already formed, notwithstanding sections 241.290 to 241.340, sequentially transferred from the conservation commission to the state park board to respective counties upon no-value certifications) and subsection 2 (islands formed after September 28, 1971, declared state property passing under subsection 1's transfer sequence and, if certified no value by both agencies, passing to counties subject to survey and sale under sections 241.291, 241.309, and 241.311). Retained both drafted titles as accurate.
